tips.speeding: Check the speed limit sign on each street and keep your speed at or below it.
tips.red_light: Start slowing down when the light turns amber and stop before the stop line on red.
tips.stop_sign: Come to a full stop at the STOP line, count to two, then check both directions.
tips.pedestrian_crossing: Slow down at every crossing and stop for anyone waiting or crossing.
tips.wrong_way: Look for one-way and no-entry signs before you turn into a street.
tips.give_way: Slow down at give-way signs and let traffic on the priority road pass before you go.
tips.collision: Keep a safe distance and look further ahead so you can avoid obstacles.
